constraints.description: Apply to actively growing weeds, free from stress. See ‘Restraints’.

usage_scenarios.weed_common_name: Up to the 4 leaf stage and not more than 120 mm in diameter
usage_scenarios.rate_full_text: Apply to crops in the 3-5 leaf (Z13-15) stage prior to late tillering. DO NOT use the 500mL/ha rate on crops younger than 5 leaf.

usage_scenarios.weed_common_name: Up to the 6 leaf stage and not more than 150 mm in diameter
usage_scenarios.rate_full_text: DO NOT apply rates higher than 250mL/ha to crops in the 3 leaf stage, especially long season varieties.

constraints.description: Residual control can be impaired by dry soil conditions and by inadequate soil surface coverage. Good soil moisture before and after application will assist performance. Good spray coverage of weeds is essential. Spray before crop canopy begins to close. Increase spray volume when weed or crop density is high.
